The '''Tipoca City embryo room''' was a location in the [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] facilities of [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]] on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. It was where the embryos of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] were developed during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It played a crucial role in the [[Inhibitor chip/Legends|inhibitor chip]] conspiracy, and it was where the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] first became aware of the technology.
